PROJECT.ONCELLEDITED: update Otkup set Certificiran = '@@Certificirana' where OtkupId = @@id
PROJECT.NAME: Projekt
PROJECT.CAPTION: Dodavanje certifikata

FILTER.NAME: FILTER
FILTER.CAPTION: Filter
FILTER.ONSUBMIT: select o.OtkupId, om.Naziv as [Otkupno mjesto1250] , p.Naziv as Partner2500, rtrim(ps.Adresa) + ', ' + rtrim(m.Naziv) as [Adresa2500] , o.Datum, o.TovarniList as Broj, o.RegBr as Registracija , vk.Naziv as [Vrsta prometa], st.Opis as [Status1000], isp.Naziv as [Isporučitelj], o.StariTovarniList as [Isporuka na/od] , k.Naziv as Kultura1650, convert(int, o.Netto) as [Netto (kg)1000] , convert(int, od.KaloKg) as [Kalo (kg)] , convert(int, o.Netto - od.KaloKg) as [Netto - Kalo (kg)1000] , convert(int, o.KolicinaSuho) as [Količina standard (kg)1000] , cl.Naziv as [Ćelija/Pista] , od.Vlaga as [Vlaga0750] , od.Primjese as [Primjese0750] , od.gmo as [GMO0500] , convert(bit, coalesce(o.Certificiran, 0)) as Certificirana1250 , case o.StatusId when 0 then 'gray' when 1 then 'black' when 2 then 'green' when 3 then 'blue' else '' end as formatid from Otkup o inner join OtkupDetalji od on o.OtkupId = od.OtkupId inner join Partneri p on o.VlasnikId = p.PartneriId inner join ParStru ps on p.PartneriId = ps.PartneriId and ps.Hqind = '*' inner join Mjesta m on ps.MjestaId = m.MjestaId inner join Kulture k on o.KultureId = k.KultureId inner join OtkupnoMjesto om on o.OtkupMjId = om.OtkupmjId inner join OtkupVrstaKnjizenja vk on o.OtkupVrstaKnjizenjaId = vk.OtkupVrstaKnjizenjaId inner join OtkupStatus st on o.StatusId = st.StatusId left join OtkupCelije cl on o.OtkupCelijeId = cl.OtkupCelijeId left join Partneri isp on o.IsporuciteljId = isp.PartneriId where (o.KultureId = @@kultureid or @@kultureid is null) and (o.VlasnikId = @@partneriid or @@partneriid is null) and (o.OtkupVrstaKnjizenjaId = @@otkupvrstaknjizenjaid or @@otkupvrstaknjizenjaid is null) and (o.StatusId = @@statusid or @@statusid is null) and o.Datum between @@datumod and @@datumdo --
FILTER.ONLOAD: select @@datumod as DatumOd, @@datumdo as DatumDo, @@kultureid as KultureId, @@partneriid as PartneriId, '@@searchboxPartneriId' as PartnerNaziv, @@otkupvrstaknjizenjaid as OtkupVrstaKnjizenjaId, @@statusid as StatusId

INPUT.NAME: KultureId
INPUT.SQL: select KultureId, Naziv from Kulture order by 2

INPUT.NAME: OtkupVrstaKnjizenjaId
INPUT.SQL: select OtkupVrstaKnjizenjaId, Sifra + ' ' + Naziv from OtkupVrstaKnjizenja order by 2

INPUT.NAME: StatusId
INPUT.SQL: select StatusId, Opis from OtkupStatus order by 1
